gloss: to run up; to dash up

definitions.gloss: to run up; to dash up
definitions.explanation: To run quickly upward, such as climbing stairs, a hill, or a slope at speed.

examples.japanese: {階段|かいだん}を{駆|か}け{上|あ}がる。
{子供|こども}たちが{丘|おか}を{駆|か}け{上|あ}がっていった。
examples.english: The children ran up the hill.

examples.japanese: {急|きゅう}いで{坂道|さかみち}を{駆|か}け{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: I hurried and ran up the slope.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
{駆|か}ける (to run, to gallop) + {上|あ}がる (to go up)

TRANSITIVITY:
{自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive) - takes を for the path being traversed

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS:
- {駆|か}け{下|お}りる: to run down
- {駆|か}け{込|こ}む: to rush in
- {駆|か}け{回|まわ}る: to run around
- {駆|か}け{抜|ぬ}ける: to run through

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {階段|かいだん}を{駆|か}け{上|あ}がる: to run up the stairs
- {坂|さか}を{駆|か}け{上|あ}がる: to run up a slope
